messages:
auditor_jane: Hi — can you provide evidence for the RBAC change on 2025-08-12 that coincided with security incident INC-2025-034? Specifically need KMS decrypt events, who triggered them, service account proof, and the control mapping to SOC 2 CC6.1/ISO 27001 A.9.2.1. Timestamp window: 2025-08-12T03:10:00Z–03:40:00Z. Also need the vulnerability triage notes and incident response runbook run id.

ella (compliance): Thanks — assigning to eng-security. @maria please collate. I'll need the SOC control mapping spreadsheet link when you have it.

maria (eng-security): On it. pulling KMS CloudTrail + internal decrypt logs now. We have decrypt events for key rk-ks-33; principal svc-inference-prod. Will attach Splunk query and S3 presigned evidence bundle.

maria (eng-security): Splunk query:
```
index=kms_logs event=Decrypt keyId=rk-ks-33 earliest=2025-08-12T03:00:00Z latest=2025-08-12T04:00:00Z | table _time user principal requestId status
```

trung (infra): FYI decrypt flow went through KMS-proxy infra-gw-2; logs include mTLS client cert thumbprint. If auditors need cert chain we can export from Vault.

nate (sre-oncall): INC-2025-034 summary: temp privilege escalation by a scheduled job; rollback executed 2025-08-12T03:28:12Z. Runbook id RB-2025-08-12-1, run_id=rbx-7782. I can provide execution trace and blameless notes.

maria (eng-security): Packaging evidence now. Evidence bundle (presigned): https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/evidence/INC-2025-034/rbx-7782/presigned (expires in 7d). Bundle contains: kms_cloudtrail.json, splunk_decrypt_hits.csv, rbac_audit_diff.json, runbook_rbx-7782.log, vuln_triage.md, pr_screenshot.png

auditor_jane: Need chain-of-custody metadata for the bundle (uploader, timestamps, signoffs) and a screenshot of the PR that changed role bindings.

maria (eng-security): Upload metadata: uploaded_by=maria, uploaded_at=2025-08-12T04:01:12Z. Signed_off_by=ella, signoff_ts=2025-08-12T04:15:00Z. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421 (screenshot included in bundle).

auditor_jane: For SOC 2 mapping: please map each artifact to CC6.1 (key management) / ISO-A.10.1 etc. e.g., kms_cloudtrail.json -> key management, rbac_audit_diff.json -> user provisioning / access control, runbook_rbx-7782.log -> incident response evidence. Short mapping ok.

ella (compliance): I'll produce the mapping doc using our CC6.1/ISO-A.10.1 convention and upload within 24h.

auditor_jane: Also saw an anomaly in last rotation date for rk-ks-33 — was rotation policy bypassed?

trung (infra): Rotation schedule: monthly. last_rotation=2025-07-15, delayed job executed 2025-07-31 due to maintenance (recorded). No bypass detected in rotation audit events. I'll export rotation_event.log.

maria (eng-security): Note: the RBAC change was applied by a Prow job `temp-priv-grant`—the justification and approver comments are in rbac_audit_diff.json. We captured the temp window and auto-revoke timestamp.

auditor_jane: OK — please push bundle + mapping doc by EOD Pacific. cc: @ella

ella (compliance): Will do. :thumbsup:

 evi dence_bot: Evidence bundle uploaded to S3, object key=INC-2025-034/rbx-7782/evidence-v1.zip, sha256=3a5f...f2b, retention=90d.

maria (eng-security): Thanks all — reaching out if auditors need deeper traces or raw cert chains.

auditor_jane: Received. Will review and follow up with any clarifying asks.
